column1: # Reserved words whose escaping the contract set does NOT execute, with why.
# D032 §4 clause 5 says a binding is a target when *"its keyword escaping is
# that question one word at a time: it emits the contract set for a target and
# looks for each reserved word's **escaped spelling** in what the emitter wrote.
# A word it does not find must have a row here, or the clause-5 cell goes red.
# ── Why this file exists at all / 이 파일이 있는 이유 ────────────────────────
# Before 2026-08-26 clause 5 had no instrument. `28-target-keywords.idl` was
# reached only by `corpus/golden/*.idl` globs, so a word was covered by accident
# and a *new* word would be uncovered by accident, with nothing red either way —
# which is how `yield` was missing from the Rust list in the first place. The
# corpus file's own header lists five classes it was measured not to carry, and
# that prose is a fact with no home: nothing read it, so nothing could notice it
# going stale. This file is that fact's home and `binding-words` compiles it.
# ── What a row costs and what it buys / 행 하나의 값 ────────────────────────
# A row is an exception and is checked in **both** directions. A word that stops
# being uncovered — because someone gave it a home in the corpus — makes its own
# row a FAILURE telling you to delete it, for the reason `differential.sh`'s
# staleness loop exists: an exception nobody removed stops describing the tree
# and the next reader believes it anyway. And a word that leaves an emitter's
# list fails too, because a row about a word the emitter no longer reserves is a
# There is deliberately **no count anywhere**. `A floor is not a figure`: a
# pinned "34 of 37 covered" would stay green while a covered word was swapped
# for an uncovered one, and would have to be edited upward by hand. Naming the
# exceptions is exact instead — adding a reserved word without covering it goes
# ── The four classes below, and which of them is a gap ──────────────────────
# `idl-keyword`  The word is a keyword in IDL too, so a contract can only name
#                it through IDL's own leading-underscore escape (`_struct`
#                declares an identifier named `struct`). No corpus file does
#                that. Not a defect; a real limit on what the corpus can say.
#                below, so a row claiming it falsely is visible in the run.
# `position`     The contract DOES name the word, in a position this target
#                never renders as an identifier. An out parameter comes back as
#                a tuple element and keeps its wire name; an attribute's
#                accessor is built as `_get_<raw>` from the unescaped name. The
#                escaping correctly does not run. Not a defect, and worth a row
#                precisely because it looks like one.
# `no-instrument` The word is not in the contract set and **nothing else
#                exercises it either**. This is the gap. It is written down
#                rather than fixed here because giving eleven Rust primitives a
#                home in a contract is a corpus batch, not a suite batch.
# `unreachable`  Stronger than `idl-keyword`: the word cannot be spelled as an
#                IDL identifier **at all**, by any escape. Added 2026-08-26 with
#                the Java target for exactly one word — `_`, which Java 9
#                removed as an identifier and which IDL cannot produce, since an
#                identifier must begin with a letter and IDL's own `_` escape
#                needs one after it. A row here can never become stale by
#                somebody adding a corpus case, which is what separates it from
# The python and rust rows were measured 2026-08-26 by the batch that built
# `spikes/binding_suite.sh`; the java rows the same day by the batch that built
# the Java client target, which is also what added the fourth class. Every row
# states which class it is, so the next reader can act on `no-instrument` — the
# only one that is a gap — without re-deriving the other three.
# *절 5에는 2026-08-26 이전까지 계측기가 없었다. 이 파일은 "이 단어의 이스케이프는
# 실행되지 않았다"는 사실의 집이며, 예외는 양방향으로 검사된다 — 더 이상 필요 없어진
# 행은 실패다. 네 부류 중 실제 구멍은 `no-instrument` 하나뿐이다.*
